Hi Jordan, I'm a recruiter at Keystone Talent Partners. One of our clients, a fintech company in Austin, has an open Data Engineering Intern role paying $38/hour. Are you open to a quick chat? It's easier to coordinate on WhatsApp, can you send me your number? The role is filling fast, so please get back to me soon.

Rachel Kim
rachel.kim.recruits@gmail.com
